tool.name: mumemto convert
tool.description: convert between MUMs and BUMbl formats

param.name: input_file
param.label: Input MUMs or BUMbl file
param.help: A .mums (text) or .bumbl (binary) file from mumemto. The format is auto-detected.

tool.help:
**What it does**
Converts between MUMs (text) and BUMbl (binary) formats. The input format is auto-detected and the output is the opposite format.
- `.mums` → `.bumbl`: converts text MUMs to binary BUMbl - `.bumbl` → `.mums`: converts binary BUMbl to text MUMs
**Input**
A `.mums` or `.bumbl` file from mumemto.
**Output**
The converted file in the opposite format.
